# components

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) | Clickable button of a script UI with a label, colors, an optional background and textures. |
| [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent) | Base of all components of a script UI: ID, position and size (in pixels or relative to the parent), anchor, margins, visibility, tooltip, mouse callbacks and custom values. |
| [`UIFormComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIFormComponent) | Shows a BBS form (a model with its animations) in a script UI. |
| [`UIGraphicsComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIGraphicsComponent) | Draws boxes, gradients, outlines and textures in a script UI. |
| [`UIIconComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIIconComponent) | Clickable icon of a script UI, by the ID of a Scram or BBS icon, with colors for the normal, hovered and disabled state. |
| [`UIItemStackComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIItemStackComponent) | Item slot of a script UI: shows an item stack and lets the player choose another one; the callback gets the chosen stack. |
| [`UIKeybindComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIKeybindComponent) | Key field of a script UI: the player presses a key or a key combination, and the callback gets it. |
| [`UILabelComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UILabelComponent) | Single-line text of a script UI with a color, shadow, background and anchor. |
| [`UIOverlayComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIOverlayComponent) | Panel with a title that opens over the screen of a script UI; its content is built by the callback given to `overlay`, and [`open`](#open) shows it. |
| [`UIScriptEditorComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIScriptEditorComponent) | Code editor of a script UI with JavaScript highlighting; the callback gets the text whenever it changes. |
| [`UITextComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextComponent) | Multi-line text of a script UI that wraps to the component width. |
| [`UITextareaComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextareaComponent) | Multi-line text field of a script UI; the callback gets the text whenever it changes. |
| [`UITextboxComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextboxComponent) | Single-line text field of a script UI with an optional length limit; the callback gets the text whenever it changes. |
| [`UIToggleComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIToggleComponent) | Checkbox of a script UI with a label; the callback runs when the player switches it. |
| [`UITrackpadComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITrackpadComponent) | Number field of a script UI that the player can type into or drag; the callback gets the new value. |
